_comment: Film 25 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD per second per sample, upload_audio_format mp3). Files go to <scratch>/sfx/<name>.mp3, NOT into the repo. After download: find the transient and set 'peak' in sound_plan.json. Library first: akzent/steps.mp3 (sfx-bibliothek) is reused for the closing steps.

dom_cascade.prompt: A long row of wooden dominoes falling one after another in a quiet room, dry rhythmic clacking that speeds up, then the last tiles settling. Close, clean, no music, no voices.

dom_tip.prompt: A single wooden domino tile tips over and clacks against the next tile, one short dry wooden click, quiet room, no music.

dom_stand.prompt: The last wooden dominoes of a long fallen row clatter and settle, then silence, one single tile left standing, a soft wooden tick and a quiet room tone. No music, no voices.

room_tone.prompt: Very quiet room tone of a small studio at night, faint electrical hum, soft air, almost silent, loopable, no music, no voices.
